output.reason: [ev-5ba316aaead4] describes netkit as "a new datapath mode" that is opt-in, with veth still the default. It never calls netkit a feature gate and names no gate, flag or config key, so the feature-gate subject is not supported. The best fit the text supports is a free-form datapath behaviour subject built from its own words: netkit-datapath-mode. The change type "added" is right, because the mode is new in 1.16.

correction.statement: Cilium 1.16 adds netkit as a new, opt-in datapath mode for Linux kernels 6.8 or newer; veth remains the default datapath device.
